name: optiland sample DoubleGauss, scaled to EFL 50 / f/2
citation: 50 mm f/2 double-Gauss, ray-traced with optiland from the optiland sample objective DoubleGauss (MIT licence)
units: optiland sample units, f = 100.004, F:2.0 (EPD 20.0), 6 elements; image gap = sample BFD (refocused by the builder)
note: Design field of the sample is about +-14 deg at 100 mm (field 14 deg, stated); full-frame 50 mm (+-23.4 deg) is BEYOND the design field, so off-axis aberration/vignetting is large by construction. No optimisation. Glasses are the sample catalog glasses (N-SSK2, N-SK2, F5, N-SK16) converted to nd/vd Abbe models (the pipeline uses AbbeMaterial); radii/thicknesses verbatim. Planar surfaces use the string 'inf'. The sample's stop is the planar surface between R5 and R6.
build_env: ISUMMICRON_BUILD_PSF_EFL_MM=50 ISUMMICRON_BUILD_PSF_EPD_MM=25 ISUMMICRON_BUILD_PSF_HALF_FIELD_DEG=23.3962047 (=atan(21.633/50)); --patent-lens must point at this same file
